description: Department of Census and Statistics - Appointment of the Superintendent of Census and Statistics
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Mrs. Dematagodage Dona Gauri Anoja Seneviratne) and her appointment to a government position (Superintendent of Census). It also provides detailed context about her responsibilities, specifically to "Superintend the taking of the Census, directed to be taken in 2023 and 2024," which constitutes a detailed description of her portfolio and duties. This combination of a named person and detailed responsibilities fits the definition of a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
